# Component Inventory
One row per UI component in `docs/build/_registry.md`, with folder, DESIGN.md source, server/client boundary, props, states, tokens, a11y, slice and tests — the contract `design-fidelity-reviewer`, `frontend-reviewer` and `spec-drift-reviewer` diff code against.
Status: DRAFT v0.2 (2026-08-17) — becomes v1.0 at freeze

Sources: `docs/build/_registry.md` (names, slices), `DESIGN.md` v1.3 (§1–§12; the look), `docs/framework-decision.md` (stack, CSS Modules), `.claude/skills/web-quality/SKILL.md` (Server/Client rules), `.claude/skills/design-fidelity/SKILL.md` (what the gate greps for), `docs/notifications.md` (email components). Sibling docs: routes/pages in `02-routes-and-pages.md`, action shapes in `04-server-contracts.md`, test IDs in `05-test-plan.md`, invariants in `01-architecture.md`.

Column key for the inventory tables in §2: **S/C** = Server Component (`S`), Client Component (`C`, has `'use client'`, reason given; every `C` file appears in the machine-readable client-island list in §1.4), or **shared** (`Sh` — no directive; presentational; renders on either side, becomes client only when imported by a client parent). **Slice** = the slice that introduces the component (registry IDs). **Tests** = the layer(s) `05-test-plan.md` must cover for it (IDs `T-UNIT-n` / `T-E2E-n` are assigned in 05; this doc names the case).

---

## 1. Rules (numbered; each is a yes/no check)

### 1.1 Files and naming
| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| C-01 | Every component in §2 lives at `components/<area>/<Name>.tsx` with a sibling `components/<area>/<Name>.module.css`. `<area>` is the registry group in kebab-case: `layout`, `primitives`, `projects`, `comments`, `accounts`, `videos`, `skins-art`, `seen-on`, `support`, `admin`. Email components live in `emails/` (see §6), never under `components/`. **Exempt from the `.module.css` requirement (no styles; 01 INV-02):** `TrackedLink`, `Icon`, `ToastProvider` (part of `Toast`), `Reply` (thin wrapper), `Nav.Viewer`. No other exemptions. |
| C-02 | `<Name>` is the registry PascalCase name verbatim (`TypeBadge`, not `ProjectTypeBadge`). Sub-parts (client or server leaves owned by a parent) live in the same folder as `<Name>.<Part>.tsx`, export one component named `<Name><Part>` (file `Nav.MenuButton.tsx` exports `NavMenuButton`; `Nav.Links.tsx` → `NavLinks`; `Nav.Viewer.tsx` → `NavViewer`; `CommentThread.List.tsx` → `CommentList`; `ArtMasonry.Lightbox.tsx` → `ArtMasonryLightbox`; `AdminShell.Nav.tsx` → `AdminNav`), and are listed in the parent's row. Sub-part files that carry `'use client'` are on the §1.4 list by path. |
| C-03 | Named export only, same as the file: `export function TypeBadge(props: TypeBadgeProps)`. Props type is exported as `<Name>Props`. No default exports (except `app/**` route files, which Next requires). |
| C-04 | CSS Modules only (`<Name>.module.css`). Class names are kebab-case and mirror DESIGN.md's component names: root class = kebab of the component (`.type-badge`, `.exclusive-badge`, `.project-card`, `.filter-bar`); element classes are root-prefixed (`.project-card-title`, `.project-card-foot`). No modifier classes (`.is-active`, `.button--primary`) — variants and states are attributes (C-10, C-11). |
| C-05 | No global CSS except `styles/tokens.css` (tokens) and `styles/globals.css` (reset, `body`, font faces, focus ring, `.visually-hidden`, `prefers-reduced-motion` base). No inline `style=` except for values that are data (masonry column count from props, progress `width: N%`, chart bar heights, `--i` custom-property indexes). |
| C-06 | No CSS-in-JS, no Tailwind, no UI kit, no icon font. Icons come from `components/primitives/Icon.tsx` (inline SVG, §2.2). |
| C-07 | A component may import only from `components/**`, `lib/**` (types, formatters, actions), `next/*`, `react`. Components never import from `app/**` or `supabase/**`. Client components never import `lib/supabase/server.ts`, `lib/supabase/admin.ts`, `lib/env.ts` (server env), or `lib/actions/*` except to pass the action into `<form action>` / `useActionState` (actions are already server-only functions). |

### 1.2 Tokens-only CSS
| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| C-08 | Every colour, spacing, radius, border width, shadow, font-family, font-size, letter-spacing, duration and z-index in a `.module.css` is a `var(--…)` defined in `styles/tokens.css`. Allowed literals: `0`, `2px`/`3px`/`4px` border and outline widths (DESIGN.md §3 fixes them: 2px borders, 3px avatars/focus, 4px admin active bar) and `6px` only for the Toast left bar (§11.1) — never `1px` (hairlines are a ❌ the contrast/grep script flags), `transparent`, `currentColor`, `inherit`, `auto`, `100%`, percentages, `fr`, unitless line-heights, `em` letter-spacing (`.06em`–`.2em`), aspect ratios (`16/9`, `16/10`, `9/16`, `3/4`), and the DESIGN.md dimension numbers (icon sizes, 44px targets, breakpoints) — those must still be `var(--size-…)`/`var(--bp-…)` where a token exists (01 §tokens). Raw hex outside `tokens.css` = ❌ (`design-fidelity` step 1). |
| C-09 | `tokens.css` mirrors DESIGN.md §1 names verbatim (`--ink`, `--slab`, … `--white`) plus the derived tokens in §9 of this doc (hexes DESIGN.md states inline without a name). No other colour tokens exist. Light theme tokens are not shipped in v1 (DESIGN.md §1 "optional, later"). |

### 1.3 Variants and states
| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| C-10 | Variants are `data-variant="<value>"` on the root element (`Button`: `primary\|secondary\|ghost\|gold\|gold-ink` — `gold-ink` is the §10 registry addition used only inside gold slabs, see the `Button` row; `VideoFacade`: `hero\|upnext\|short\|mention`; `Avatar`: sizes via `data-size`). Values are the DESIGN.md words in kebab-case. |
| C-11 | Interaction states use CSS pseudo-classes only: `:hover`, `:active`, `:focus-visible`, `:disabled` (native `disabled` attribute), `:checked`, `[open]` on `<details>`. Never a JS-driven `data-hover`. |
| C-12 | Logical/lifecycle states are a single `data-state="<value>"` on the root, mutually exclusive, values enumerated per component in §2 (e.g. `HandleField`: `resting\|checking\|available\|invalid`; `UploadWell`: `idle\|dragover\|uploading\|done\|error`; `Comment`: `published\|held\|hidden\|deleted\|editing`). A component with no lifecycle state has no `data-state`. |
| C-13 | Selection/pressed/expanded/invalid/current are ARIA, not data attributes, and CSS keys on the ARIA attribute: `aria-current="page"` (nav), `aria-current="true"` (selected thumb / up-next row / skin card), `aria-current="true"` also on the active FilterBar type link (`<a>`, never `aria-pressed` on a link), `aria-pressed` (LikeButton, SkinViewer3D Spin/Walk — `<button>` only), `aria-checked` (Toggle; `role="radio"` chips inside `role="radiogroup"`: ReportPicker, AmountPicker), `aria-selected` **only** inside `role="listbox"`/`role="tablist"` (no v1 component uses it), `aria-expanded` (burger, ProfileMenu trigger, ChangelogExpander summary), `aria-invalid` + `aria-describedby` (Field, HandleField, Composer), `aria-busy` (skeleton regions, submitting forms), `aria-disabled="true"` on the unavailable `Chip` (`<span>`, not focusable). |
| C-14 | Boolean flags that are not states use `data-<flag>` with no value: `data-exclusive` (ProjectCard, SkinCard), `data-featured`, `data-own` (Comment), `data-creator`, `data-mod`, `data-anonymous` (LeaderboardRow), `data-compact` (FloatingSupportButton phone), `data-sticky` (GetItPanel desktop). |
| C-15 | Every state DESIGN.md enumerates for a component must be reachable and rendered (`design-fidelity` step 2). Missing state = ❌. Extra states not in DESIGN.md = "UNSPECIFIED" → ADR or `DESIGN.md` edit in the same PR. |

### 1.4 Server / client boundary
| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| C-16 | Server Components by default. `'use client'` appears only in the files listed in the machine-readable client-island list below (C-16a), which mirrors 01 INV-08 plus the amendments recorded in §10; the two route files `app/error.tsx` and `app/global-error.tsx` (Next requirement, G-03) are the only `'use client'` files outside `components/`. A `'use client'` in any other file = ❌ (`frontend-reviewer` "Boundaries"; `scripts/check-client-islands.mjs`, 01 INV-94, parses the list between the `client-islands:begin/end` markers). |
| C-16a | **Client-island list (machine-readable).** One row per file that may carry `'use client'`. `01` column: `=` on the 01 INV-08 allowlist as written · `+` amendment (registry addition §10, needs the ADR 01 INV-08 names at S0) · `≠` 01 lists the parent as client but this doc narrows it to the leaf named. See table after this one. |
| C-17 | Client components receive data as props; they never fetch (01 INV-09: no `fetch`, no Supabase reads, no `lib/data/*`, no `lib/supabase/server.ts`). The four explicit exceptions, each a Server Action or a browser-side auth/upload call: (1) `HandleField` calls the `checkHandle` action (`lib/actions/accounts.ts`); (2) `SkinViewer3D` loads its texture URL (image fetch by skinview3d); (3) `GoogleSignInButton` calls `supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth` from `lib/supabase/client.ts` (02 §4 — the only `lib/supabase/client.ts` import in `components/**`); (4) `UploadWell` PUTs the file to the `signed_url` returned by the `begin` phase (04 §1.4.5 — the only browser `fetch`/`uploadToSignedUrl` in `components/**`; `AvatarUpload` sends its file inside the parent form's FormData instead). Mutations go through `lib/actions/*` (04) via `<form action>`, `useActionState`, or `startTransition`. |
| C-17a | Session-aware parts of ISR pages (`Nav.Viewer` = sign-in block vs `ProfileMenu`, `CommentThread` data incl. the viewer's own held/hidden rows and `liked` flags, mod toggles) are **Server Components rendered inside a `<Suspense>` boundary** (01 INV-39; fallback = the signed-out/skeleton shape). They read the session through `lib/auth.ts` + `lib/data/*` and pass plain props down; no client component uses `lib/supabase/client.ts` for reads. **Conflict with 02 RP-01/O-1 (client-side reads) is OPEN — see O-22; this doc follows 01.** |
| C-18 | Heavy client dependencies are lazy: `skinview3d` (`next/dynamic`, `ssr:false`, in `SkinViewer3D` only), `Lightbox` (dynamic import on first open, 01 INV-10). `react-markdown`+`remark-gfm` are imported **only** in `lib/markdown.ts` (01 INV-65/INV-86); the `Markdown` Server Component wraps `renderMarkdown()` and imports nothing from those packages; they never enter a client bundle (there is no client markdown preview in v1 — see O-23). Any new client dep > 50 KB gz → stop and ask (web-quality; ADR-R5). |
| C-19 | Composition pattern: a server parent renders the shell and passes serialisable props (or server-rendered `children`) to a small client leaf (`Nav` → `NavLinks` + `NavMenuButton`; `CommentThread` → `CommentList`; `VersionsTable` → `ChangelogExpander` (children = server-rendered `Markdown`); `AdminShell` → `AdminNav`; `ArtMasonry` → `ArtMasonryLightbox`). Prop values must be JSON-serialisable (no Dates, no functions except server actions). |

### 1.5 Reuse — do not create a new component if…
| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| C-20 | …a §2 row already covers it with a variant/state (a "gold button" is `Button data-variant="gold"`; a "selected chip" is `Chip selected` (`aria-checked`/`aria-current`); a "held row status" is `StatusPill status="held"`). Duplicates = ❌ from `spec-drift-reviewer` check 4. |
| C-21 | …it is a page-level arrangement of existing components (project detail header, "What it pays for" slab, the Find-me column). Those are composed inside `app/**` route files or `components/<area>/<Page>Section.tsx` **only if** used on ≥2 routes; otherwise inline in the route (framework-decision guardrail "no abstraction until needed twice"). |
| C-22 | …it is a Silkscreen micro-label (`PixelLabel`), a section header (`SectionTitle`), a status word (`StatusPill`), a square picture (`Avatar`), an empty state (`EmptyState`), a one-line inline confirm (`InlineConfirm`), a third-party logo (`PlatformMark`), a source colour (`SourceSwatch`), or a NOTE box (`NoteCallout`). Those primitives exist for exactly that reason (§2.2, §10). |
| C-23 | A component that DESIGN.md does not describe cannot be added by a build PR alone: it needs (a) a DESIGN.md §-reference, or (b) a DESIGN.md edit + `keep-docs` + an ADR in `docs/build/06-decisions/`, and (c) a row added to this doc and to `_registry.md`. `design-fidelity` stops and asks otherwise. |

### 1.6 A11y and motion baseline (applies to every row)
| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| C-24 | Minimum hit target 44×44 CSS px on every interactive element (DESIGN.md §5). Visual size may be smaller (chips, 28px trigger) only with padding/pseudo-element making the target 44. |
| C-25 | Focus: `:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 2px }` defined once in `globals.css`; components never remove it and never set `outline: none` without replacing it with the same ring. |
| C-26 | Meaning never rides on colour alone: badges = glyph + word; statuses = worded pills; active nav = underline; selected chips = fill + `aria-checked`/`aria-current`; charts = swatch + word; toggles = ON/OFF word (DESIGN.md §1, §9, §11.1). |
| C-27 | Text minimums: body ≥16px (`--text-body` 17px desktop / 16 phone), UI/prose never <13px, Silkscreen ≥10px and ≥11px when informational (counts, `HELD FOR REVIEW`, `N TOTAL`, view counts). Bungee ≥16px for titles; 12–15px only for button/filter/support labels. |
| C-28 | Motion: transitions 120–180ms ease-out, moves ≤4px, one idle animation per page; under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` transforms are dropped and colour changes kept (globals.css sets `* { transition-property: color, background-color, border-color, outline-color, box-shadow }` under the media query). Skeleton pulse holds at opacity .8. |
| C-29 | Images: `next/image` with explicit `sizes`; every image has `alt` (empty `alt=""` only for the decorative hatch/avatars duplicating adjacent text); pixel art (`skins`, project icons, allay) uses `image-rendering: pixelated` at integer scales. |
| C-30 | Copy inside components follows DESIGN.md §7: no emoji (the `♥ ★ ✔ ✕ ⏳ ⠿ ▾ ↗` characters DESIGN.md prescribes are typographic glyphs and allowed exactly where prescribed), "Download" never "Get", handles only, plain-language errors inline beside the thing that failed, never a modal for errors. |

## 3. State vocabulary (canonical `data-state` values)

| Component | `data-state` values (mutually exclusive) | ARIA/flags used instead |
|---|---|---|
| `NavMenuButton` (panel) | `open` \| `closed` | `aria-expanded` on burger; `aria-current="page"` on links (`NavLinks`) |
| `FloatingSupportButton` | `visible` \| `hidden` | `data-compact` |
| `Toast` | `entering` \| `visible` \| `leaving` | `role=status` |
| `Button` | — | `disabled`, `aria-busy` (pending); `data-variant` incl. `gold-ink` |
| `Chip` | — | `aria-current` (links) / `aria-checked` (radio chips), `aria-disabled` (unavailable) |
| `Toggle` | — | `aria-checked`, `disabled` |
| `Field` / `Select` | — | `aria-invalid`, `disabled` |
| `HandleField` | `resting` \| `checking` \| `available` \| `invalid` | `aria-invalid` |
| `AvatarUpload` | `empty` \| `cropping` \| `uploading` \| `error` \| `done` | `role=progressbar` |
| `UploadWell` | `idle` \| `dragover` \| `uploading` \| `done` \| `error` | `role=progressbar`, `role=alert` |
| `VideoFacade` | `idle` \| `loading` \| `playing` | — |
| `Lightbox` | `open` \| `closing` | `<dialog open>`, `aria-modal` |
| `SkinViewer3D` | `loading` \| `ready` \| `unsupported` | `aria-pressed` on Spin/Walk |
| `CommentThread` (shell) | `normal` \| `empty` \| `closed` \| `banned` \| `signed-out` | — |
| `CommentList` | — | `data-moderate="on\|off"` |
| `Comment` | `published` \| `held` \| `hidden` \| `deleted` \| `editing` | `data-own`, `data-creator`, `data-mod`, `data-depth="0\|1"` |
| `Composer` | `idle` \| `submitting` \| `error` | `aria-invalid`, `aria-busy` |
| `LikeButton` | — | `aria-pressed` |
| `ReportPicker` | `picking` \| `sending` \| `done` \| `error` | `role=radiogroup` + `role=radio aria-checked` |
| `InlineConfirm` | `closed` \| `open` \| `pending` | — |
| `ProfileMenu` | `open` \| `closed` | `aria-expanded`, `role=menu` |
| `OnboardingPanel` | `idle` \| `submitting` \| `error` | — |
| `MentionCard` | `idle` \| `playing` | — |
| `MentionPreview` | `empty` \| `preview` \| `error` \| `manual` | `aria-live` |
| `AmountPicker` | — | `role=radiogroup` + `role=radio aria-checked` |
| `KofiPanelSlot` | `idle` \| `loaded` | — |
| `ProjectCard` / `SkinCard` | — | `data-exclusive`, `aria-current` (SkinCard selected) |
| `GetItPanel` | — | `data-sticky` |
| `LeaderboardRow` | — | `data-anonymous` |
| `ChangelogExpander` | — | `aria-expanded` on the summary button; expanded `<tr hidden>` toggled |
| `ReorderableList` (row) | `grabbed` \| (none) | `aria-live` announcements |
| `SyncStatus` (row) | — | `aria-busy` on the Sync now button |

Rule C-31: a component's `.module.css` may only select the values listed for it here (`[data-state="held"]`); a selector for an unlisted value = ❌.

## 4. Nav specification (S0, S1.1, S1.2, S2.2)

| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| N-01 | Sticky top bar: `position: sticky; top: 0`, height 68px desktop / 56px phone (`--nav-h`, `--nav-h-phone`), background `--slab`, `border-bottom: 2px solid var(--line)`, `z-index: var(--z-nav)`. Content max-width `--measure-page` (1280), gutters 24 phone / 40–56 desktop. |
| N-02 | Left: `Avatar size=40` (default 3px `--white` border — DESIGN.md §3) of the OddSense avatar (`public/brand/avatar-80.png`, `alt="OddSense"`) + wordmark `ODSENS` (Bungee 20px, `--white`), together one `<a href="/">` with `aria-label="odsens home"`. **There is no Home item.** |
| N-03 | Desktop link order (≥900px), exactly: **Projects** (`/projects`) · **Videos** (`/videos`) · **Skins** (`/skins`) · **Art** (`/art`) · **Seen on** (`/seen-on`) · **Commissions** (`/commissions`, rendered only when `FLAGS.commissions` from `lib/flags.ts` is true — false until S2.2; 01 INV-74). Space Grotesk 15px 500 `--mute`, padding 10×14 (O-11). Hover: `--chalk`. Active: `aria-current="page"`, `--white` 700, `box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 var(--gold)`. **Active item = pathname `===` href or `startsWith(href + '/')`** (02 RP-12; `/projects/[slug]` highlights Projects). Support is **never** in this row. Rendered by `NavLinks` (client leaf, `usePathname`). |
| N-04 | Right side, in order: `SearchBox placement="nav"` (renders itself only on `/projects` — RP-12) · `Nav.Viewer` Suspense slot: signed-out → `GoogleSignInButton label="Sign in" from="nav"` styled as the outlined block (14px 700, 2px `--line-strong`) / signed-in → `ProfileMenu` · gold Support `Button variant="gold" size="sm" href="/support"` label `♥ SUPPORT` (Bungee 12px, `3px 3px 0 --gold-deep`; the floating one is 13px/4px — O-11) wrapped in `TrackedLink event="tip_click"` (`{from:'nav'}`). |
| N-05 | Under 900px: links + Sign in/ProfileMenu collapse behind a 44px square `<button aria-label="Menu" aria-expanded aria-controls="nav-menu">` (`Icon menu` / `close`) = `NavMenuButton`. Its panel opens as a full-width `--slab` panel under the bar with the same order, **Support last** (as a full-width gold `Button`). Wordmark and (on ≥600px) the gold Support button stay visible in the bar; on phone the Support button lives only in the menu (see O-10). Esc closes; focus returns to the burger; body scroll locked while open. |
| N-06 | Admin link: role ≥ moderator sees "Admin" inside `ProfileMenu`, not in the row (admin login page not linked publicly — security-check; O-6). |
| N-07 | `SkipLink` is rendered before `Nav`; `<main id="main">` follows. |
| N-08 | Nav has no idle animation; menu open/close is 150ms opacity/translate ≤4px; reduced-motion = opacity only. |
| N-09 | `Nav` (server shell in `app/layout.tsx`) takes no props: link list is a constant in `Nav.tsx`, `FLAGS.commissions` is read directly (`grep -n "FLAGS.commissions" components/layout/Nav.tsx` must hit — 01 INV-74 check), the viewer slot is `Nav.Viewer` inside `<Suspense>` (C-17a). |

## 5. Global states — skeletons, 404, error, toast, empty (S0, per DESIGN.md §11)

| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| G-01 | Every route segment that fetches data has `loading.tsx` rendering the matching skeleton: **`app/loading.tsx` = hero-slab `Skeleton kind=media` + 4 `ProjectCardSkeleton` inside the page shell (02 RP-09/§6; nav/footer render from the layout)**; `/projects` → `ProjectCardSkeleton count=6` in the real grid; `/projects/[slug]` → `ProjectDetailSkeleton`; thread → `CommentThreadSkeleton` via `<Suspense>`; other data pages → `Skeleton` blocks in the page shell (02 §6 table). Never more than one screenful; nav/footer render immediately (they are outside the suspense boundary). |
| G-02 | `app/not-found.tsx` = 80px Bungee `404` in `--indigo` (on `--ink`; the numeral is decorative-large, contrast rule exempt because "THAT PAGE DOESN'T EXIST" carries the meaning), then Bungee "THAT PAGE DOESN'T EXIST" (`--chalk`), "Probably never did." (`--mute`), `Button primary` GO HOME + `Button ghost` "See the projects". `h1` = THAT PAGE DOESN'T EXIST. Route-level `notFound()` from `/projects/[slug]`, `/admin/*` (signed-in non-mod, 02 RP-04) etc. renders the same. |
| G-03 | `app/error.tsx` and `app/global-error.tsx` (client boundaries, Next requirement — **the two allowed `'use client'` route files outside §2, both on the C-16a list**) = 64px `--alert` square with `!` (Bungee, `--white`) and `5px 5px 0 var(--alert-deep)`, "SOMETHING BROKE", "Not your fault. Reload and it's usually fine. If it isn't, it's on the list.", `Button primary` RELOAD (`reset()`) + `Button ghost` "Go home". **No error codes or stack text**; the digest is logged, not shown. `app/global-error.tsx` mirrors it with inline minimal styles (no CSS Modules guaranteed there). |
| G-04 | Toasts: only success confirmations of ≤3 words ("Comment posted." · "Saved." · "Copied." · "Approved." · "Hidden." · "Banned." · "Sync started." · "Published."). Errors are never toasts (C-30). Bottom-left so it never overlaps `FloatingSupportButton` (bottom-right). |
| G-05 | Empty states use `EmptyState` with the DESIGN.md §11.7/§12.4/§11.2 strings verbatim: Videos "NO VIDEOS YET / They'll show up here when they exist." → channel link · Skins "NO SKINS YET / Working on it. Check the projects meanwhile." · Art "NO ART HERE YET / Nothing in this filter. Try \"all\"." · Projects "NOTHING MATCHES / Try fewer filters." → Clear filters · Comments "NO COMMENTS YET / Say something." → primary button · Leaderboard "NOBODY YET / Be first." · Admin orders (S2.2) "No orders yet / Quiet week. The form still works." · **Seen on surfaces with zero mentions render nothing** (§12.1); the `/seen-on` filter-with-no-results case is 02 O-7 (proposed `EmptyState` "NOTHING HERE / Try another filter.") — O-25. Admin tables with no rows: `Table empty=` one `--mute` line in voice (e.g. "Nothing held. Nice.") — copy in 02. |
| G-06 | Skeleton colours: `--skeleton-media` (= `#1E2938`, alias of `--slab-raised`) and `--skeleton-text` (`#1A2432`); pulse `--dur-skeleton` 1.6s opacity 1→.55; `prefers-reduced-motion` → static opacity .8. |

## 6. Email components (`emails/`) — email-safe subset (DESIGN.md §12.1, `docs/notifications.md`)

| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| E-01 | Files: `emails/components/{EmailLayout,EmailButton,EmailBadge}.tsx`, `emails/templates/{CommentNew,CommentHeld,CommentReported,SyncFailed}.tsx` (P2: `OrderNew`, `WorkroomUpdate`), `emails/preview/*` for `pnpm email dev`. Rendered only in `lib/notify/deliver/email.ts` via `@react-email/render` → `{ html, text }`. Never imported by `app/**` or `components/**`. |
| E-02 | Styles are inline (React Email `style={{}}` — the one place inline styles are mandatory) using the DESIGN.md hex values listed in §2.11; a unit test asserts every hex used in `emails/**` exists in `styles/tokens.css` (parity check, since `var()` does not work in mail). |
| E-03 | Allowed subset: `background-color`, `color`, `border: 2px solid`, `padding`, `font-family` fallbacks (Impact, "Arial Black", Arial, sans-serif for display; Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif for body), `font-size ≥ 13px` (body 16), `text-transform`, `letter-spacing`, `width` on tables/images. **Forbidden**: `outline`, `box-shadow`, gradients/hatch, web fonts, animation, `border-radius` other than 0, JavaScript, remote CSS. |
| E-04 | Layout is table-based, max 600px, explicit dark backgrounds on `body`, wrapper and card (Gmail dark-mode inversion guard); `<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">` + `supported-color-schemes`. |
| E-05 | Exactly one `EmailButton` per template; `tone="gold"` only in `CommentHeld` (APPROVE). Every template has: preview text, `EmailBadge` for the event kind, the allay lead line from DESIGN.md §12.1 verbatim, one excerpt (≤ 280 chars, HTML-escaped, links stripped), the button, footer with "The allay emails you because <switch> is on." + "Manage in Settings" (absolute URL to `/admin/settings`) + one dry sign-off. |
| E-06 | Plain-text version is generated for every send (`render(..., { plainText: true })`) and passed to Resend `text`. Subject lines are ≤ 60 chars, no emoji. |
| E-07 | Wordmark ships as PNG (`public/brand/email/wordmark.png`, 2× for retina, `alt="odsens"`); the allay 28px header image is added when the asset lands (Q44) — templates must not break without it. Images are absolute `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` URLs. |
| E-08 | No PII in template props (types accept `handle`, never email/name); admin recipient addresses are applied by the deliverer, not the template. Discord embeds are not React components — `lib/notify/deliver/discord.ts` builds the JSON (title "Event — Project", excerpt, "View" link, colour bar indigo `#4B45D6` default / gold `#FFC61F` held+reported / alert `#CC3A2A` failures; username `allay`, avatar = allay render URL when it exists). |
| E-09 | `design-fidelity` covers `emails/` (notifications.md): the reviewer opens `pnpm email dev` renders or the exported HTML and checks E-02–E-07. |

## 7. Preview / story approach

**OPEN (O-1)** — proposed default: a dev-only route `app/dev/components/page.tsx` (`/dev/components`) that returns `notFound()` when `process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'` **and** on any Vercel deployment (`process.env.VERCEL_ENV` set) — it exists only for `pnpm dev`/local Playwright. It renders every §2 component in every §3 state from `tests/fixtures/ui/*.ts` fixture data (no DB), grouped by area, each block labelled with `PixelLabel` "<Name> · <state>" and wrapped in `<section data-preview="<Name>">`. Purposes: `design-fidelity` screenshots (1280 + 390) diffed against the **pass-2 and pass-3 prototypes per component** (`design/claude-design-export/pass-2/*.dc.html` for the base set the gate agent names, `pass-3/*.dc.html` for the §12 additions), axe on the whole set (05 to add `T-E2E components a11y` — §10), contrast script. No Storybook (extra toolchain for Oliver; a route is one file). Emails preview via `pnpm email dev` (already decided). If rejected → alternative is Storybook 8 with the same fixture set. Decision recorded as `ADR-<next>-component-preview.md` in `06-decisions/` at S0 (number assigned at creation; ADR-N1). 02 must add `/dev/components` (dev-only) to its route table if O-1 is accepted (§10).

## 10. Registry additions (to be added to `_registry.md` / sibling docs; not edited here)

**Components (v1 unless marked):** `SkipLink`, `NoteCallout`, `SectionTitle`, `Avatar`, `Icon`, `PlatformMark`, `SourceSwatch`, `GoogleSignInButton`, `EmptyState`, `InlineConfirm`, `TrackedLink`, `SearchBox` (= 02 §10 "`SearchBox`"; formerly `SearchField` in v0.1 of this doc), `Breadcrumb`, `Skeleton` (base), `ToastProvider`/`useToast` (part of `Toast`), **`VideoCard`** (videos; renders the `/videos` long-form grid and Home "Latest videos" 2-up), **`ReorderableList`** (admin; ⠿ reorder for `/admin/mentions` featured order and `/admin/projects`); sub-parts `NavLinks` (`Nav.Links.tsx`), `NavMenuButton` (`Nav.MenuButton.tsx`, name per 01 O-8), `Nav.Viewer` (server partial), `CommentList` (`CommentThread.List.tsx`), `ArtMasonryLightbox` (`ArtMasonry.Lightbox.tsx`), `AdminNav` (`AdminShell.Nav.tsx`). Phase 2: `MilestonePills`, `ParticipantsRow`, `WorkroomPost`, `WorkroomFilesList`, `WorkroomStatusRail`, `EmailOptInPanel`, `OrderForm`, `OrderConfirmation`, `OrdersTable`, `OrderDetail`; folders `components/workrooms/`, `components/orders/`.
**`Button` variant** `gold-ink` (registry lists `primary|secondary|ghost|gold`): `--gold-ink` fill, `--gold` text, `3px 3px 0 --gold-deep`; allowed only inside gold slabs (`TipPanel`, `AmountPicker`) — DESIGN.md §11.4.
**`StatusPill` statuses** beyond DESIGN.md's list: `stale`, `failed` (SyncStatus), `suggested` (S2.4), `first-comment`.
**01 INV-08 client-island allowlist amendments** (need the ADR 01 INV-08 names, at S0): `+` `NavLinks` (`usePathname` for `aria-current`; 01 says "link list server-rendered"), `+` `InlineConfirm`, `+` `TrackedLink`, `+` `GoogleSignInButton`, `+` `SearchBox`, `+` `ReorderableList`; `≠` `CommentList` is the client leaf under the server `CommentThread` shell (01 already says shell = server). Full list = §1.4 C-16a table (the INV-94 machine-readable list).
**01 INV-09 wording:** add "a browser-side `supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth` call from `GoogleSignInButton` and the signed-URL `PUT` from `UploadWell` (04 §1.4.5)" to the allowed network list (C-17 exceptions 3–4).
**01 INV-10:** drop `FlatBarChart` (server-rendered inline SVG, no client JS — O-23) and "`Markdown` editor preview in admin" (no client markdown preview in v1: admin ABOUT/changelog preview is the server `Markdown` re-rendered on the form's Preview submit — O-23), or keep and 03 changes; OPEN.
**01 INV-59 / 04 / 00 S1.9 analytics payloads:** `download {project, source, from}`, `tip_click {amount?, from}`, `video_play {id}`, `sign_in {from}` — the `from` key is this doc's addition (04 owns payloads; 00 S1.9.AC8 no-PII test covers it). No `external_out` event.
**04 asks:** `postComment` (and the thread read shape in `lib/data/comments.ts`) returns `author.id`, `edited_at`, `first_time` (mods only) alongside the documented `{id, body, status, created_at, author:{handle, avatar_path, role}, like_count, liked, parent_id}` — needed for `data-own`, "· edited" and `FIRST COMMENT`. `site_settings.creator_profile_id uuid null` (data-model + `updateSettings`) — decides the `CREATOR` tag (O-15). `triggerSync` is not offered for `skins` (no enum value) — `SyncStatus` shows the row without a button.
**02 asks:** add `/dev/components` (dev-only, O-1) to the route table; note that `Nav` search is `SearchBox` (client, self-hiding off `/projects`); RP-01/O-1 vs C-17a — see O-22.
**05 asks:** `T-E2E components a11y` (axe over `/dev/components`, O-1); e2e cases named per row in §2 (this doc names the assertion, 05 assigns IDs); component logic that is unit-tested lives in `lib/` (`lib/analytics.ts` allowlist, `lib/versions.ts` grouping, `lib/handles.ts`, `lib/uploads.ts` pre-check + copy, `lib/format.ts`, `lib/comments/errors.ts`, `lib/settings/matrixDiff.ts`, `lib/stats.ts` bucketing) — no component render/snapshot tests (05 COV-6, O-24).
**00 asks:** S1.1.AC8 ("signed-in role `user` → same gate") to be amended to match 02 RP-04 / 05 T-E2E-33 (404) — O-17.
**Modules:** `lib/analytics.ts` (`track` wrapper + `TrackProps` allowlist), `lib/versions.ts`, `lib/handles.ts`, `lib/uploads.ts` (`UPLOAD_KINDS`, referenced by 04 U4), `lib/format.ts`, `lib/flags.ts` (already 01), `lib/markdown.ts` (already 01).
**Routes:** `/dev/components` (dev-only, O-1). No auth sign-in route: sign-in is a client `signInWithOAuth` call (02 §4); the registry's `/auth/callback` + `/auth/sign-out` are the only auth routes.
**Assets:** `public/brand/marks/*.svg` (Modrinth, CurseForge, YouTube, Ko-fi, TikTok, Twitch, Reddit), `public/brand/email/wordmark.png`, `public/brand/allay-*.png` (Q44), `public/brand/avatar-80.png`.
**Tokens:** §9 table.
**DESIGN.md edits via `keep-docs` (each with an ADR line, ADR-R2):** §5 Chip vs Project card chip cap (O-14); §5 Nav link rest/hover/size metrics + nav Support button metrics (O-11); §11.1 Toast queueing (O-13); §11.1 facade scaling on small variants (O-19); §11.3 sync status design (O-16); §12.2 `/seen-on` filter-empty (O-25, 02 O-7); §12.1 link-out chip wording (O-26).

## Review notes (findings not applied as written, with reasons)

| Finding | Disposition |
|---|---|
| "Reconcile `Nav.Links` … keep links server-rendered with `aria-current` computed from a `pathname` prop passed by the layout" | Not possible in the App Router: `app/layout.tsx` (server, ISR) has no pathname without `headers()`, which makes every route dynamic (breaks 01 INV-38/02 ISR). Kept a client `NavLinks` leaf and recorded it as an INV-08 amendment (`+`) in C-16a and §10, per the finding's alternative ("record the differences as an ADR that amends 01 INV-08"). |
| "`VideoFacade`: state 'play block 88px on every variant, both chips on every variant'" | Took the finding's second option (O-19): an 88px block does not fit a 104px-wide Short or a 132px Up-next thumb; scaling proposed, DESIGN.md edit via `keep-docs` at S1.6. |
| "`FlatBarChart` … or mark it `C` + `next/dynamic` per INV-10" | Took the first option: kept `S` (inline SVG needs no client JS, which is the intent of INV-10) and listed the INV-10 amendment as OPEN O-23. |
| Test-harness finding option (b) (jsdom + RTL Vitest project) | Chose option (a) (O-24): re-mapped every component Tests cell to e2e assertions and `lib/` unit tests, matching 05 COV-6 and 01 INV-78 as written. |
| Registry-addition request "`site_settings.creator_profile_id`" | Applied as a proposed default under O-15 (not a decision — data-model/04 own the column). |
